offer.text: You have never slept a night away from a roof, have you. Walk into the woods, walk into the next village, and sleep somewhere that is not your own house.

accept.text: Take a bed with you. Or make friends quickly.

in_progress.text: Woods, village, morning. In that order or any other.

ready.text: You look like a person who has slept outdoors. That is a compliment.

complete.text: Now you know what the drovers mean by a short night.
